Utan KV-cache skulle varje varv räkna om: Without a KV cache, every pass would recompute the whole sequence. With the cache, only the new position is computed, but every pass still has to read all the weights. That is the basis for everything in module 6.

W_U (unembedding, <span class=\"mk\">lm_: W_U (unembedding, lm_head) gives one number per token in the vocabulary and per position. The logit at position t is the model’s estimate of what comes at position t + 1.
Vid generering behövs bara <b>sista rade: During generation only the last row is needed. vLLM therefore computes logits only for the last position of each sequence. Computing all T rows for a long prompt would waste T × 128,256 numbers.

One number per token in the vocabulary.
2. Vad gör temperature 0,5 jämfört med 1: 2. What does temperature 0.5 do compared with 1.0?
Logits delas med temperature. Mindre än: The logits are divided by the temperature. Less than 1 amplifies the differences.
Antalet kandidater anpassar sig: få när: The number of candidates adapts: few when the model is confident, many when it is unsure.

Under träning är hela texten känd och al: During training the whole text is known and everything is computed in one pass. During generation the next token does not exist until it has been drawn.
